turns.speaker: mturk_agent_1
turns.text: I need at least 2 food packages and at least 1 water. I can live with out any extra firewood.

turns.speaker: mturk_agent_2
turns.text: Please do understand my situation its very very critical to give 2 food packages to you.Instead you can take 3 waters and firewood too.

turns.speaker: mturk_agent_1
turns.text: No that will not work for me given that I have 4 growing children of different ages who eat like adults. I need at least 2 food packages and 1 water. That gives you 1 food package and 2 waters and 3 firewoods.

turns.speaker: mturk_agent_2
turns.text: I too have children who eat like adults they too can't able to withstand hunger so you please show some mercy and give me 3 food packages and take all water and firewood

turns.speaker: mturk_agent_1
turns.text: No I need extra food too. I cannot let my children starve and you cant let your children go thirsty. So if you cant agree to share the food i will walk away from the deal.

turns.speaker: mturk_agent_2
turns.text: There is no point in walk away. This deal should be done mutually and beneficial for both. So its better I will take 2 food packages, you can take 1 food package, 2 water and 3 fire wood .Hope this will definitely work for you.

turns.speaker: mturk_agent_1
turns.text: No i absolutely need 2 food packages and 1 water. How about we do it like this... You take 1 food package, 2 waters and 2 firewoods. Does that work for you?

turns.speaker: mturk_agent_2
turns.text: Sorry to bother you, I don't need anything other than food package. So better you could give me 2 food package and take 3 water and fire wood. Please consider this deal.

turns.speaker: mturk_agent_1
turns.text: No i absolutely need 2 food packages. So if you cannot agree to take 1 food 2 water and 2 firewood i will walk away.  If you have children with you would would also need water which you are not asking for.

turns.speaker: mturk_agent_2
turns.text: Yes I too have children so only I am considering 2 food package, 1 water is enough for me and I dont need any firewood. So please accept this deal

turns.speaker: mturk_agent_1
turns.text: 😡 I am walking away if i cannot get 2 food packages 1 water and 1 firewood. That leaves you with 1 food 2 waters and 2 firewoods. This is a good deal for you concidering that you havent been asking for water for your children until i mentioned that you need water for you children. Do you agree??

turns.speaker: mturk_agent_2
turns.text: I already mentioned that 1 water is enough for me.But food is my only priority for my children so you please consider this and help me in this.

attribution: Kushal Chawla, Jaysa Ramirez, Rene Clever, Gale Lucas, Jonathan May, Jonathan Gratch. 2021. CaSiNo: A Corpus of Campsite Negotiation Dialogues for Automatic Negotiation Systems.
selection_rationale: 同じ食料2個以上の要求と拒否が反復し、新しい合意基準・譲歩が作られない。turn18の退出だけではなくturn6–17の反復を根拠とする。
